restrictions: Messages are exactly 135 bytes; each is one padded block M || 0x86 with zero capacity (520 fixed state bits). Complete fixed-zero-IV SHA3-256 sponge with suffix 0x06 and pad10*1, prefix rounds 0..4, 256-bit digest.

This package (v19) is Meganpark980320's v18 (f1eb6445; v17 168a1b3a), itself rubenmarcus's v15 (91f1424d) on winglock's v14 (f1cedf6b, with Th0rgal), with three cheaper counted programs and two development items added (proof U); computation, outputs, caps, constants and success evidence are v18's. (1) T3: per_a once per (a, block) (A's 7 words, the match counter advanced by the run length, its M_CAP test: 11, inside the 2^6 sort-and-merge price, 37 + 11 = 48) and match_step per match (62, was 83): same AS, decisions and counts (U.1). (2) E stage 1 with the 24 words of D1[0] in registers (64-register model): 69,242 per block of 256 steps (was 75,386; U.2). (3) T2: digest-plane rows bitsliced, the leaf a 12-gate test of ALLOW: 56 per leaf with its step (was 166; U.3).

(4) D15 completed: the T1/T2 run that wrote cores.bin, the input of every native T3 run of D15, was not charged by v15-v18; v19 charges it at the counted prices, 2^26.5335 units (U.4). (5) D19: every run we made for v19 (prototypes, build checks, the feasibility run contig.c and its export, an accounting run) at counted prices, 2^28.9135 units; local executions of the organizer's harness are verification (v15's rule), listed and priced: 33.76 if charged (U.5). Every R5 and R6 run is a complete run of v19: each change computes the same values in the same order and no cap, constant or rule changes (Lemma 6c, U.6).

No advice: the algorithm runs every phase itself, and its time is the sum of caps, fixed counts and organizer-recomputed counts times counted prices or stated bounds (proof 2, 6, U, V): P 2^28.6592 units (T2 2^26.0135, matches 2^24.6390); B' 2^29 units (B_TRUE) plus one update; at most 2^13 connector attempts of at most X_MAX = 2^20 work units (2^29.4539); E: K = 96 spaces, setup at most 2^16 units, 2^16 unrolled blocks of 256 Gray steps at most 69,242 counted primitives each (2^28.2602), at most S2CAP = 2^21 stage-2 pairs per space (2^29.3970). Algorithm 2^31.3507.

Development (proof 0.1, U, V, H2): every target-specific run whose result fixed, or under its plan could have changed, a number the algorithm reads, at the counted prices of the submitted programs: G2 2^30.9994 and C 2^31.9189 (B' at true cost, E spaces at v19's E), D15 2^32.0899 (with U.4), D16 2^27 (v17's bound), D19 2^28.9135. Total 2^33.7207, claimed 33.7208; preprocessing 33.53. Sensitivities, not claimed: match step at 83: 33.83; E at 75,386: 33.77; T2 at 166: 33.75; our local organizer runs charged: 33.76; D19 doubled: 33.78; S2CAP 2^11 (not adopted, U.7): 33.65; D15 doubled: 34.13; v17's B' re-derivations charged: 34.30; A1 charged as in v18: 40.99.

Premise P (inside H1; success only): P outputs the trail of proof 3 within M_CAP. P's native run certified it at its level of 64 blocks (W* = 127 <= 2 x 64 - 1, Lemma P: every leaf with AS(alpha2) <= 63 is found, every other leaf has w1 >= 128), with 7,251,935 matches; the organizer recomputes the structural counts, the output core's level (r5-count trial 10), seed-picked cores (r5-mitm-0, 1) and P's driver on a sub-problem with its cap. If P certified nothing it would output nothing; every cost bound holds either way.

Probability space: the algorithm's own coins (B' candidate coins, connector coins), fixed target, no advice. Success is measured end to end (proof 5): R6, v15's pre-registration (plan and code hashed before any run, 48 complete runs of v15, all reported; each is also a complete run of v19, Lemma 6c and U): 44 of 48 succeed, one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson bound 0.8193. R5, v14's pre-registration, consists of complete runs of v15 (Lemma 6): 46 of 48, bound 0.874. Claimed 0.40; each study alone supports it. No new success run was made for v19.

Executed evidence (not the claimed cost): R6 and R5 (proof 4.2, 4.7, Appendices D, E), with 7 R6 and 8 R5 collisions as certificates; r5-R-0..7 re-derive 16 seed-picked R5 successes per review; r5-bpfull runs a whole B' from its label and reports its true cost; r5-count checks the counted stage 1 step by step against plain evaluation with v19's per-step counts (U.2), the bitsliced T2 leaf on all 32 row values and 64 leaves (U.3), P's driver and cap, P's certifying level on the output core; r5-mitm-1 checks the counted half-vector step over both half tables of the output core and, on 4 seed-picked level-64 blocks, per_a (exactly 11) and match_step (exactly 62) against the plain evaluation (U.1); r5-trail-0..3 recount T1, T2 and the half vectors.

heuristics.statement: Averaged over all of the algorithm's own coins (B' candidate coins, connector coins), the probability p that v19's algorithm outputs a collision satisfies p >= 0.40. Premise R (run selection and coins): the SHA-256/SHAKE-256 coins of labels fixed before the runs act as fresh coins, and the 48 runs of each pre-registered study (R6, ours; R5, v14's) are an unselected sample of the algorithm's runs, so that their success indicators are independent Bernoulli(p) draws. Premise P: P outputs the trail of proof Section 3 within M_CAP.
heuristics.scope: Only the success probability. Each R6 and R5 run is a complete run of v19 with label-derived coins (proof Lemma 6c, U): v19 differs from v18 only in three counted programs that compute the same values in the same order (U.1: the same AS, decisions and match counts, CapReached at the same (a, block) run; U.2: the same stage-1 words; U.3: the same leaf decisions, so the same 467 kept cores) and in its development ledger; caps, constants and rules are v18's. v18 differs from v15 only in the stage-1 program (same words, Lemma 4; proof V.7), the programs that compute P's T3 (same keys, matches and decisions, r5-mitm-1 trials 1-2), in B''s true-cost tally (B' unchanged) and in the caps X_MAX = 2^20, S2CAP = 2^21 and B_TRUE = 2^29 units, which no R5 or R6 run reached (largest attempt 190,240 work units, stage-2 count 315, true B' cost 2^28.27 units; every R5/R6 B' run re-derived, proof V.5). Each R6 run is a complete run of v15 with label-derived coins (proof Lemma 6a: v14's B', connector and driver code, P's certified trail, E as fes with stage 2 and S2CAP; no cap that should not act acted), and each R5 run is one too (Lemma 6b: v15 computes v14's outputs). Premise P concerns success only: every cost term of P is a fixed count, an organizer-recomputed count or a cap. Output correctness and every cost cap hold without H1.
heuristics.extrapolation: R6: 44 of 48 runs succeed; under premise R the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson bound is 0.8193, so by R6's pre-registered rule the claim 0.40 is supported. R5: 46 of 48, bound 0.8746. The studies are not pooled. Premise R: R6's plan, driver, analysis, launcher, enumerator and P program were hashed at 2026-10-08T00:19:33Z before any run and made read-only; every run is reported (proof 4.7, Appendix E: per-run ledger with result-file hashes); the plan's only outcome-dependent rule is whether to claim; every other run made for v15 is listed (proof 4.1). Premise P: P's native run certifies the trail by Lemma P; it agrees with v14's exhaustive T3 passes; the organizer re-runs the output core's certifying level, seed-picked cores and P's driver on a sub-problem. Organizer checks of R5 as in v14 (r5-R-0..7, r5-bpfull); 7 R6 and 8 R5 collisions are certificates.
heuristics.limitations: Label-seeded SHAKE-256 coins stand in for fresh words (premise R). R6's failures, run order and timing are logged by us; the organizer re-derives no R6 run (the experiment file's 64-KiB budget holds only R5's table), but 7 R6 collisions are certificates. R5's limitations are v14's. No new success run was made for v19. P's full-scale certification rests on our native run (296 CPU-s, reproducible from Appendix A); the organizer checks 3 of 467 cores per review at the certifying level.

heuristics.statement: The charged development - v14's G2 (2^30.9994 units) and C (2^31.9189 units) with their B' runs at true cost and their E spaces at v19's counted E (re-derived from their labels by v17), v15's D15 at the counted prices of v19's programs computed only from v15's published itemization plus the T1/T2 run that produced D15's input cores.bin (2^32.0899 units), v17's D16 (2^27 units, bound) and our D19 (2^28.9135 units, every run we made for v19 except executions of the organizer's harness) - contains every target-specific run whose result fixed, or under its plan could have changed, a number that v19's algorithm reads, and these prices are the ones the cost model requires. The caps X_MAX, S2CAP and B_TRUE come from v13's run-free rule. Every other run produced program text, verified logged results or fixed no number of v19 (A1: proof V.6; our local organizer runs: U.5).
heuristics.scope: Only the development (preprocessing) part of the time and preprocessing claims. The algorithm's own terms (2^31.3507) are caps, fixed counts and recomputed counts at counted prices or stated bounds, and do not depend on H2.
heuristics.extrapolation: Proof 0.1 and U.5 list every run (v15's list, D16, the B' re-derivations of V.5, which fix no number, and every run made for v19 with hashes). D15 at v19's prices is computed from v15's published D15 itemization only (V.3, U.6): v15's rounded charges taken rounded up, v15's stated match counts at their smallest rounding, and only the match and key prices changed; U.4 adds the T1/T2 run behind cores.bin at N1 x 2^12 + C1 x 56 + 2^32 primitives. G2's and C's B' runs were re-derived from their labels by v17 (outputs and WK costs equal the logs) and are priced at the true cost of V.5, which is at most WK's at every event; their E spaces at v19's counted block (U.2). D19 is itemised in U.5 at counted prices (the feasibility run at 62 + 31 primitives per match, above its measured machine-instruction count). Proof 0.2 gives the origin of every number; v19 adds no number. A1 produced program text, not an input of the algorithm (V.6), as in every qualified package of this lineage.
heuristics.limitations: Repricing development at the submitted programs' prices is the rule v14, v15 and v17 applied. Sensitivities: our local organizer runs charged 33.76; D19 doubled 33.78; D15 doubled 34.13; v17's B' re-derivations charged 34.30. A1 (v7's design study, 10,432 CPU-s) stays uncharged as in v13-v18; charging it gives 40.99. D15's largest item is an upper bound (the stopped run is charged complete). D16 is v17's stated bound, inherited.
